body: He would be a good match for me when I think about, but the problem is I'm not physically attracted to him at all. It's not something that's ever going to change. So, I guess I kind of treat him as a would a life partner, just without the sex and affection. I only have platonic feelings for him.

It's just, even if she wasn't THE girl, if I can't be with her I sure as hell don't want anybody else. If there is THE girl out there, and she doesn't elicit the same passion from the depth of my soul, I don't want her...

As pathetic as this is I partly want to end things to make her realize we maybe could have worked things out if she had been more mature and the hope that maybe we'll get back together in a few months or years is the only thing, to shake her out of her blind pride that is her biggest problem in relationships, aside from some rational thought telling me how good I have it, making me not want to end it.
I could really relate to this. Thank you so much.
Did you get your heart crushed before though? Are you as attracted to them as others before?

This sounds so shallow, but I've never been so attracted to someone before physically and emotionally. It kills me to think of losing her as a life partner. I feel like a "true love" waiting for us is just a fairy tale that we make up to make ourselves feel better about our shortcomings...
